caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a banjo, oriented vertically and centered on the page. The banjo has a round, light beige body bordered in blue-gray, and five tension brackets around its perimeter. The neck of the banjo is long and colored brown, with four visible strings extending from the rounded tuning scroll at the top down to the bridge, which is light brown. The banjo’s tailpiece is highlighted in a gold-yellow color. There is a rectangular inset on the upper left, showing a side profile of the neck in pencil, including tuning pegs and construction details. In the bottom right, a smaller rectangular inset outlines a mechanical or structural detail of the banjo’s head and supporting rod, drawn in pencil. The drawing is enclosed within light pencil borders and uses muted colors against a cream-colored background with some brownish aging and wear marks, especially in the upper section. The artist’s signature “Sharp” appears just below the body of the banjo to the right.
title: Plantation Banjo
